DevOps Engineer

Own the delivery platform for a telecom client.

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain Kubernetes clusters
- Automate infrastructure with Terraform
- Design CI pipelines in Jenkins
- Optimize Docker build and deploy times

Requirements:
- 4+ years of strong Kubernetes experience, must have
- Terraform required
- Docker required
- AWS exposure is nice to have
